crossRefs.note: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.
Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.
The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into…
“Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.

people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

translations.web: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:
translations.bsb: From the sons of Asher, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
translations.kjv: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
translations.asv: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers' houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
